text: Your first week shapes everything that follows
Starting a new job is a strange mix of excitement and paperwork. For most newbies, the first week decides whether they feel welcome or quietly start looking elsewhere.
Tarnhollow Onramp gives HR teams one place to plan that first week, from signed contracts to the first team lunch. It is the best-in-class way to help people settle in.
Our customers see the difference quickly. 92% of new hires finish their onboarding checklist within five days.
It doesn't stop at the first week either. Companies that move to Tarnhollow regularly cut onboarding time.
On average they do it by 80%, which leaves managers free to spend that time with their teams.
And we're only getting started. Next year, Bluewren will bring a personal assistant to every line manager, so nobody misses a check-in.
